title: Detailed rainbow
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='g1' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ff3b3b'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#ff8a3b'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='g2' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ff8a3b'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#ffe23b'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='g3' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ffe23b'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#4bff6a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='g4' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#4bff6a'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#3bd4ff'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='g5' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#3bd4ff'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#5b6bff'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='g6' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#5b6bff'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#b45bff'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- clouds at the base -->
  <ellipse cx='18' cy='88' rx='16' ry='7' fill='#d8e4ff'/>
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='84' rx='12' ry='7' fill='#eef4ff'/>
  <ellipse cx='82' cy='88' rx='16' ry='7' fill='#d8e4ff'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='84' rx='12' ry='7' fill='#eef4ff'/>

  <!-- rainbow arcs, outer to inner -->
  <path d='M8,88 A42,42 0 0 1 92,88' fill='none' stroke='#ff3b3b' stroke-width='5'/>
  <path d='M13,88 A37,37 0 0 1 87,88' fill='none' stroke='#ff8a3b' stroke-width='5'/>
  <path d='M18,88 A32,32 0 0 1 82,88' fill='none' stroke='#ffe23b' stroke-width='5'/>
  <path d='M23,88 A27,27 0 0 1 77,88' fill='none' stroke='#4bff6a' stroke-width='5'/>
  <path d='M28,88 A22,22 0 0 1 72,88' fill='none' stroke='#3bd4ff' stroke-width='5'/>
  <path d='M33,88 A17,17 0 0 1 67,88' fill='none' stroke='#5b6bff' stroke-width='5'/>
  <path d='M38,88 A12,12 0 0 1 62,88' fill='none' stroke='#b45bff' stroke-width='5'/>

  <!-- soft glow highlights along the arcs -->
  <path d='M8,86 A42,42 0 0 1 92,86' fill='none' stroke='#ffd0d0' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M18,86 A32,32 0 0 1 82,86' fill='none' stroke='#fff6c0' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M28,86 A22,22 0 0 1 72,86' fill='none' stroke='#c8f4ff' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <circle cx='12' cy='20' r='1.4' fill='#fff6a0'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='18' r='1.2' fill='#c0f0ff'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='12' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='30' r='1' fill='#ffd0f0'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='28' r='1' fill='#d0ffe0'/>
</svg>
